content:
Welcome! #Hello, everybody! Welcome to my blog which I’ve decide to name ‘Cloudburst’s Musings’, at least for the time being.
My name is Dominic and as of writing this, I am 26 years old.
I’m not 100% sure what kind of content I will be posting on this blog, but it’s most likely going to fall within some of the things listed below:
Anime 🗾 Life Updates 🐚 Music 🎵 Photography (Film & Digital) 📷 Self-Hosting / Homelabbing 🖥️ TV/Movies 🎥 Video Games 🎮 I want to admit that I’m not entirely making this for an audience although I feel that it’s kind of the point of creating a blog that is publicly accessible. I first and foremost want to make this for myself and create/write about things that I find interesting and worth talking about, and hope that others feel the same and end up finding their way here at some point.
With all of that said, I want to welcome all of said people who happened to find their way here! I hope you find some sort of value in my blog :)
summary: Just a welcome to all who may stumble upon this blog!
title: Welcome To My Blog!

content:
Hello to anyone who may be reading this! 👋
My name is Dominic but most people end up calling me Dom somehow. I’m 26 years old and currently living in the Southern US, although I’m originally from the Midwest.
I spend most of my time outside of work either playing video games, reading manga, watching TV/Anime/Movies, walking, , taking pictures, homelabbing, or hanging out with my girlfriend and our dog.
